name: Type I fibre (slow-twitch)
short_description: A slow-twitch, oxidative skeletal muscle fibre built for endurance: a single unbranched, cylindrical cell running centimetres long (~40-60 um across), with hundreds of nuclei flattened at the PERIPHERY just under the sarcolemma, regular cross-striations (A/I bands, Z-disc to Z-disc sarcomeres) alongside lengthwise myofibrils, and dense packing of mitochondria and myoglobin that give it a deep red colour and an essentially inexhaustible aerobic ATP supply, fed by a rich surrounding capillary bed.
